name.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（0910 实验版 + 正式版）

versionNote.zh: 版本以逐运行的快照记录为准；不填单一版本号，避免把两个快照合并成一个未经验证的值。
versionNote.en: Version is recorded per run as a snapshot; no single version number is claimed, to avoid merging two snapshots into an unverified value.

evidence.zh: harness 报告值，记录在 phase-02 各运行的 submission.json；phase-01 归档未记录 model id。
evidence.en: Harness-reported value, recorded in each Phase 2 submission.json; the Phase 1 archive does not record a model id.

evidence.zh: 正式版 harness 报告的 model id 待第一次运行后回填，不据品牌名推断。
evidence.en: The GA harness-reported model id will be filled in after the first GA run; not inferred from the brand name.

notes.zh: 按组织者 2026-09-10 决定，0910 实验版与随后发布的正式版 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 视为**同一个模型**，成绩同表记录；每个运行单独记录 harness 报告的模型 id（即快照），跨快照比较必须标明差异。实体 id 与全部运行 URL 保持稳定，不因改名而变动。
notes.en: Per the organizer decision of 2026-09-10, the 0910 experimental preview and the subsequent GA release of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash are treated as **one model**, with results reported in the same table. Every run records its harness-reported model id (its snapshot), and cross-snapshot comparisons must be labelled. The entity id and all run URLs stay stable and are not renamed.
